pages.text:
Chapter 1: Wickermoor Hollow

A fog-bound valley cut off from the world. The villagers keep the Old Ways…
The blacksmith, Yorgrim, hammers through the night. Few know what he buries behind the forge…
Fated Tarot Reading. If The Fool was pulled, the character's Whistle becomes an uncommon magic item…

threads.summary: A story about beginnings and reckless hope. 6 Narrative Touchpoints spread across the campaign.
